title: Weekend Plans
description: Four short recordings about weekend plans: friends chatting, a school notice, a phone message and an invitation.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Chatting about the weekend
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and Emma talking on Friday.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Hi, Nam. What are you doing this weekend?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: On Saturday, I'm going to play football with my cousins. We play at ten o'clock.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: That sounds fun. What about Sunday?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I'm going to visit my grandparents. They live in a small village. We usually eat fish and rice together.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Lovely! I'm not going out on Saturday. I want to stay at home and read my new book.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Don't you want to go to the cinema? There is a good film on Saturday evening.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Hmm, maybe. But I'm very tired this week. I think I'll watch TV and go to bed early.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK. Have a nice weekend, Emma!

parts.title: Part 2 · A school notice
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Mr Baker, talking about a weekend club.

script.speaker: Mr Baker
script.text: Good morning, students. This is a notice about our weekend art club.

script.speaker: Mr Baker
script.text: The club is on Sunday morning, not Saturday. It starts at nine o'clock and finishes at eleven.

script.speaker: Mr Baker
script.text: This week, we are going to paint pictures of animals. Please bring an old shirt, because paint can be messy.

script.speaker: Mr Baker
script.text: The club is free, but we need your name. Please give it to Miss Hill at the school office.

script.speaker: Mr Baker
script.text: After the club, we will have a snack. There will be apples and orange juice. See you on Sunday!

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear a message from Linh to her friend Peter.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Peter. It's Linh. Are you free on Saturday? I have a plan.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Let's go to the lake. We can take a picnic. I'll bring sandwiches and some fruit.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Can you bring the drinks? Maybe water and lemonade. And please bring a ball, too.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The weather is going to be sunny, but it's a little cold in the morning. So take a jacket.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Let's meet at the bus stop at nine o'clock, no, sorry, half past nine. Call me back, please. Bye!

parts.title: Part 4 · An invitation
parts.intro: You will hear Mai inviting her friend Jack to a party.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Jack, it's my birthday next Saturday. Can you come to my party?

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Yes, of course! How old are you going to be?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'm going to be eleven. The party is at my house, at four o'clock.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Great. What are we going to do?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: First we're going to play games in the garden. Then we'll eat pizza and cake.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: I love pizza! Do you want a present?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: No, please don't buy a present. Just come and have fun!

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: OK. I'll come with my sister. Is that all right?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, she's very welcome. See you on Saturday!
